highlights: **Engineering leadership:** Set the architecture and review designs across Baze (Safaricom platform) and BBRaiN; plan and assign technical work to engineers; own all technical communications.
**Platform modernisation:** Led the upgrade of Baze's Spring services to Java 21 and Spring Boot 4, resolving breaking changes across every service; now leading the move to Java 25.
**Operational excellence:** Own runbooks, deployment change requests and incident response, with root-cause analyses.
**Quality gates:** Maintain the performance, smoke and end-to-end test suites, SonarQube checks and CI/CD pipelines that every release passes.
**Sole engineer on BBRaiN:** Designed and built the Rust AI engine behind search, recommendations and personalisation on Baze (Safaricom platform), deployed inside each client's own cloud (VPC).
**AI in the binary:** Serve vision, embedding and ranking models from one Rust service on CPU, with no GPU runtime, within a tight latency budget.
**Payments and revenue:** Built Baze's revenue-sharing engine from scratch, with an auditable payout workflow, and contributed to its payment, catalog and auth services in Java and Spring Boot.
**Analytics and playback:** Built Baze's analytics service for event ingestion and campaign attribution, and the playback events that flow through Kafka into ClickHouse and on to recommendations.
**AI integration:** Integrated ML models and LLM APIs into Go, Java and Python microservices.
**LLM features:** Built prompt, retrieval (RAG) and structured-output features for client-facing tools.
**Data preparation:** Cleaned, transformed and validated client datasets for modelling and analytics.
**Prototype to production:** Turned validated AI prototypes into services with MLOps pipelines.
**Evaluation and documentation:** Tested model outputs against baselines and documented APIs.
**Service performance:** Cut inter-service overhead by 30% by moving services to Go and gRPC.
**Streaming pipelines:** Ran Kafka pipelines with sub-second ingestion for real-time monitoring.
**Team standards and mentoring:** Set code-quality and DevSecOps standards, reviewed code, and mentored apprentice engineering teams.
**Real-time systems:** Built Go (REST, WebSockets) and Java Spring Boot backends for startups.
**Full-stack delivery:** Integrated Angular frontends with Go and Java backends.
**Reliability:** Deployed Dockerized services with auto-scaling and monitoring, holding 99% uptime, and resolved production incidents for clients.
